title: Annotated Gemini orbital photo #12 (mounted inverted): U.S.–Mexico border terrain
description: Black-and-white orbital terrain photograph mounted upside down on a white card, so the "#12" marking and the "N" orientation mark appear inverted (N at bottom). Handwritten labels, also inverted, mark mountain ranges, a railroad and a dashed "U.S. MEXICO" border line, with a further dashed line along the right side. The print shows desert basins and ranges with light streaking near the top edge.
